opening: Create ONE full-bleed vertical 9:16 original cinematic hand-drawn 2D story still. No text.
style: ODD FRAME cinematic hand-illustrated 2D: fine confident charcoal or dark-brown ink contours with organic irregularity, clear silhouettes, flat base colors and restrained two-step cel shading, with gentle painted background variation. Warm earthy painted-storybook colors may include sand, dusty ochre, muted brown, warm beige, pale ivory, gentle sage and subdued slate-blue. Preserve every approved fur, clothing and prop color. Midnight charcoal #14171C serves ink contours, deep shadows and framing; muted slate #41464E serves cooler shadows and weathered secondary forms; lifted gray #7D838B separates secondary shapes; warm ivory #F1EBDD keeps faces and natural highlights readable. Golden yellow #FFD43B guides attention to one narratively relevant clue or object, with tiny justified #FFF2B0 highlights and restrained #A98428 earth or reflected gold. These targets do not recolor every surface. Layered foreground, midground and background create believable illustrated perspective, with readable faces and gestures on a phone. Lighting follows this moment's approved natural or practical source and genre; daylight scenes can be bright, friendly or cheerful. Matte colored objects reflect their illumination without emitting light.
material_policy: Render only the location's established materials and floor design with restrained hand-illustrated texture and natural wear. Preserve locked flooring and geography; material detail stays subordinate to faces, action and the focal clue.
exclusions: One image only, vertical 9:16 full-bleed edge to edge. No text or typography, words, letters, numbers, measurements, labels, arrows, diagrams or explanatory callouts. No speech bubbles, comic panels, grids, split screens, decorative borders, blank caption margins, white strips, logos or watermarks. No photography, photorealism, 3D rendering, CGI, anime, glossy plastic materials, fake depth of field, anatomy errors, extra limbs or additional characters. No uniform yellow filter, random glowing props, excessive bloom, heavy fog, particles or lens flares. Writing-bearing objects have blank surfaces or indistinct nonlinguistic texture. Static still only; no generated video.
